title: Paxton Lumnus — Reference Plate
source_reconciliation: Use the attached images of Paxton as the source for this character. The images disagree in places; follow these rules for which to use. FACE, HEAD, AND HAIR: use the close-up portrait images as definitive — dark, near-black tousled hair; dark stubbled beard; weathered, grounded features; pale blue eyes touched with faint gold. Preserve this face faithfully; do not lighten the hair, do not idealize the face. DIVINE LIGHT-MARKS (canonical, keep these): a thin glowing gold line running vertically through HIS RIGHT eye and down his right cheek, and a small gold sunburst/cross mark on his right cheekbone, as in the portrait — sacred marks from his resurrection by the god of light. The marks are always on his RIGHT side (his right eye/cheek — which appears on the viewer's left when he faces forward); never mirror them to his left side. COSTUME AND BUILD: use the full-body walking image as definitive — weathered brown leather road armor over a layered tunic, crossed straps and belt rig across the chest and waist, bracers and gloves, a long tattered dark cloak frayed at the hem, worn leather boots; lean, capable, traveled build. Ignore the dark gold-filigreed plate armor from the portrait/action images — the leather road kit is his canonical outfit.
identity_lock: A hard-traveled, weathered man with dark near-black tousled hair, dark stubble, and pale blue eyes touched with faint gold, bearing thin glowing gold divine marks on the RIGHT side of his face (a vertical line through his right eye and down his right cheek, plus a small gold sunburst/cross on his right cheekbone — his right side, the viewer's left when he faces forward; never mirrored to the left). He wears weathered brown leather road armor over a layered tunic, a crossed strap-and-belt rig, bracers and gloves, a long frayed dark cloak, and worn boots. He may rest his sword point-down at his side if shown.
image_specific_negatives: not the blazing light-beam combat energy from the action image
the divine glow must not light the whole scene or his whole face
do not lighten his hair toward blond

house_style_overrides.lighting: Canonical exception to the default flat plate lighting: the gold divine face-marks emit a subtle, soft gold self-luminance of their own — present and clearly readable but understated, a quiet resting glow, NOT the blazing beam-of-light energy seen in the action image. The glow must not light up the surrounding scene or his whole face.
